transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

Well… my regular doctor was worried because I’ve gotten, um, too thin, I guess. I didn’t really think it was such a big thing at first, but my work pants are hanging pretty loose on me now. And… I suppose I do feel a little relieved when the number on the scale is lower, which I know probably isn’t the right way to think about it.
Have you been having episodes where you eat a lot in a short amount of time, more than most people would in similar circumstances?
Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not sitting down and eating huge amounts all at once, if that’s what you mean. I try to keep things pretty controlled. I’m answering that right, I think?
Have you been doing anything like making yourself sick, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual to try to control your weight?

Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not trying to do anything extreme like that. I do try to stay active with work and all, but I wouldn’t say I’m… doing something on purpose like making myself sick or anything. Is that what you mean?
Do you find yourself being very worried about gaining weight or feeling like you might gain weight, even when others might not see you that way?

I mean… I wouldn’t say I’m worried all the time, exactly. But yes, I guess if I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I do get kind of nervous the rest of the day that it’s going to show on me. I’ll check myself more, like how my clothes feel or in the mirror, and then I start thinking I need to make up for it somehow. Is that… the kind of thing you’re asking?
Have you ever made yourself vomit or used laxatives specifically to try to control your weight or shape?
No… I haven’t made myself throw up or used laxatives for that. I know people do things like that, but I don’t. I just… try to be careful, I guess. Is that okay to say?
Have you been fasting, following very strict diets, or setting rigid rules about what and when you can eat to try to control your weight or shape?

I don’t know if I’d call it fasting, exactly… I mean, I do cook proper plates for my husband and my mother-in-law. I make sure they have enough.

But by the time I sit down, I’ll usually tell myself I don’t really need much. Like coffee is fine, or maybe a few vegetables, or half a piece of toast. It feels… more sensible, I guess. I know that probably sounds a bit strict when I say it out loud.
On most days, how much do you typically eat compared to what you think your body might need? Do you find yourself intentionally eating much less than you should?

I suppose… yes, probably less than I should, if I’m being honest. I don’t mean to make it sound dramatic. I’ll cook normal plates for my husband and my mother-in-law, and I’m fine doing that, but then when it’s my turn I usually think, well, coffee is enough for me, or just a few vegetables… sometimes half a piece of toast.

It feels sensible at the time, like I don’t need as much. But I guess most days it is quite a bit less than what someone would probably say I should eat. Does that make sense?

Even though you're eating less than most people probably should, does it come from a strong fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, or is it more about feeling like you don’t need much or it’s just sensible?

I’d like to say it’s just being sensible… and maybe some of it is. But, um… yes, I do get scared about it.

If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I’ll spend the rest of the day worrying it’s going to show on me somehow. I keep checking myself, and then I start thinking I need to make up for it. I know that probably sounds silly… I don’t want to make a fuss, but that’s what happens.
Do you see yourself as overweight or needing to lose weight, even when others might not see you that way?

I don’t know if I’d say “overweight,” exactly… that sounds a bit harsh. But I do feel like I need to keep myself small, if that makes sense.

When I’m neat and not taking up much space, I feel like I’m handling things properly. But if I look in the mirror and my stomach seems even a little full, I get this horrible feeling like I’ve let myself go. I know other people might not see it that way… I just have trouble not seeing it.
When you look at yourself in the mirror, do you see yourself differently than how others might describe you, like seeing yourself as larger than you actually are?

Yes… I think I do, though I feel a bit embarrassed saying it.

Other people might say I look fine, or even tell me not to worry, but when I look in the mirror I notice my stomach straight away. If it looks even the least bit full, I feel like I’ve let myself go somehow. When I’m small and neat, I feel like I’m managing properly… like I’m doing things right. Does that make sense?
